title: TaxoSAE: Rethinking Sparse Autoencoders through Taxonomic Logic
abstract: arXiv:2610.31894v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) decompose the representations of large language models (LLMs) into interpretable features, enabling precise readout and control of encoded knowledge. However, existing SAEs treat each feature as a standalone unit, whereas real-world knowledge is often taxonomically organized. As a result, readout carries no guarantee of taxonomic consistency, and control lacks the granularity to specify the scope of an edit. We propose TaxoSAE, which explicitly encodes taxonomical information, built on is-a (hypernym-hyponym) relations, into the SAE feature space. TaxoSAE mirrors a taxonomy with a stack of SAEs, one per taxonomy level, and introduces a taxonomic alignment loss that trains each concept to be active whenever one of its hyponyms is. On two factual QA taxonomies, one over biographical relations and one over animals, TaxoSAE enables (1) more accurate readout through the taxonomy with concentrated activations,

translated_title: TaxoSAE：通过分类学逻辑重新思考稀疏自编码器
translated_abstract: 最近的稀疏自编码器（SAE）能够将大语言模型（LLM）的表示分解为可解释的特征，从而实现对所编码知识的精确读取与控制。然而，现有的SAE将每个特征视为独立单元，而现实世界的知识往往是以分类学方式组织的。因此，读取操作无法保证分类学上的一致性，控制操作也缺乏指定编辑范围的粒度。我们提出了TaxoSAE，它将分类学信息（建立在is-a即上位词-下位词关系之上）显式地编码到SAE特征空间中。TaxoSAE通过一组堆叠的SAE来镜像分类树结构，每个分类层级对应一个SAE，并引入了一种分类对齐损失，训练每个概念在其任一下位概念激活时也保持激活状态。在两个事实问答分类树（一个关于人物传记关系，一个关于动物）上，TaxoSAE实现了：（1）借助分类树进行更准确的读取，且激活更加集中，
tldr: TaxoSAE通过在稀疏自编码器特征空间中显式编码is-a分类学关系，利用按分类层级堆叠的SAE结构和分类对齐损失，实现了对大语言模型知识更准确且具分类一致性的读取与更精细粒度的控制。
en_tdlr: TaxoSAE explicitly encodes taxonomic is-a relations into the SAE feature space using stacked SAEs per taxonomy level with a taxonomic alignment loss, enabling more accurate, taxonomically consistent readout and finer-grained control of LLM knowledge.
